quote: you can file a claim online [here](https://myclaimportal.cunamutual.com/link/contract?ContractNumber=01401789) or by calling 800-621-6323
qualifiers: for already enrolled members; administered by TruStage

value: Optional add-on that may cancel or reduce loan payments if loss of life, disability, involuntary unemployment, accidental dismemberment, terminal illness, hospitalization or family medical leave occurs
quote: Payment Protection is an optional add-on that may cancel or reduce your loan payments if something unexpected happens

value: Enrollment is voluntary and not required to obtain a loan
quote: Enrollment in this Payment Protection product is voluntary and not required to obtain a loan.

value: Cost depends on loan amount, term and protection package; fees calculated on outstanding loan balance and adjust as balance changes
quote: The cost depends on your loan amount, term and protection package you select. Fees are calculated based on your outstanding loan balance

value: Joint borrowers can be covered at no additional cost
quote: Joint borrowers can be covered at no additional cost.

value: New and existing closed-end consumer loans, Visa balances, and home equity lines of credit
quote: Payment Protection is available for new and existing Dupaco: Closed-end consumer loans, Visa balances, Home equity lines of credit

value: Pre-existing conditions are excluded during the first six months of coverage; pre-existing condition means advice, diagnosis or treatment (including medication) in the six months prior to enrolling
quote: Pre-existing conditions are excluded during the first six months of coverage.

value: Coverage may be cancelled at any time; cancellations within the first 30 days are eligible for a refund of fees paid
quote: You may cancel coverage at any time, and cancellations within the first 30 days are eligible for a refund of fees paid.

value: Does not affect loan approval or terms
quote: Payment Protection is optional and does not affect loan approval or terms.

value: Zero deductible, repairs at any ASE-certified mechanic nationwide, direct payment to shop; three packages all include rental and towing reimbursement, 24-hour roadside assistance and emergency travel expenses
quote: You get zero deductible, repairs at any ASE-certified mechanic nationwide and direct payment to the shop. Choose from three packages

value: Guaranteed Asset Protection covers difference between loan balance and insurance payout if vehicle totaled or stolen
quote: Guaranteed Asset Protection covers the difference between your loan balance and your insurance payout
qualifiers: available on new, used and refinanced autos

value: Premium can be included in loan payments or paid at loan closing
quote: the premium can be included in your loan payments or paid at loan closing

value: Covers difference between loan balance and vehicle MSRP or NADA Retail value at time of loss if totaled or stolen
quote: DPW covers the difference between your loan balance and the vehicle’s MSRP or NADA Retail value at the time of loss.

value: May cancel up to $1,000 of remaining balance
quote: Coverage includes accidental death protection, which may cancel up to $1,000 of your remaining balance.
